flows.title: Create a task
steps: Click the + button at the top of the workspace.
In the pop-up, type the title of the new task and press Enter.

flows.title: Search the workspace
steps: Click the Search icon in the sidebar to open the search box.
Type an item's or a person's name, keywords, or an ID number.
Select the item from the list when it appears, or click Show more for more results in each category.
To see every task that matches, click the Search icon or press Enter.

flows.title: Share a task
steps: Go to the folder, project or space the task is in, and open the task in Item view.
Click the three-dot menu at the top-right corner, then Share.
Enter the name of the person or user group in the search field, and click their name in the list.
